Road Warriors was amazing, I would have never expected any of that.

 

Also John Hunt, The Hunter, and Night Hunter... So much cheese I had to share it, and get dirty looks from everyone who assumed those were my jokes and not someone elses.

 

Though, now I do need to ask, why did Ansel need to die? The Chrono-Ranger episode made it sound like he showed up before the trap was sprung and stopped Ambuscade from killing a hero. This episode makes it sound like Chrono-Ranger showed up after Ambuscade's trap was defeated by Tachyon... so what would have happened had Chrono-Ranger not interfered?

 

I'm defintely submitting a question about this
